title: Universal Base Characters
summary: Two rigged, textured human bodies by Quaternius, a man and a woman in underwear, with 8 hair, beard, and eyebrow models; imported ready for universal-animation-library's clips.
useWhen: A 3D game needs stylized humans with realistic proportions that play the Universal Animation Library's clips at once, varied by hair and skin tint, in underwear or in outfits made in Blender.
avoidWhen: Chibi or fantasy heroes with weapons (use kaykit-adventurers), a body shape or age these two do not cover (use MPFB), or clothed characters with no time to model their outfits.
copyright: Bodies and hair by Quaternius (quaternius.com); the import settings, bone maps, and retarget.gd that WASD Engine adds are also CC0-1.0
